metadata.title: Nhà Sách Mây — good books for quiet reading hours
metadata.description: A bilingual Vietnamese/English online bookstore: literature, business, self-help, children's books and more.

home.quote: The reading of all good books is like conversation with the finest minds of past centuries.

login.title: Sign in
login.description: Welcome back to the reading room.
login.emailConfirmed: Your email is confirmed. Sign in to continue (the link was opened in a different browser, so you were not signed in automatically).

register.title: Create an account
register.description: Save delivery addresses and track your orders.
register.checkInbox: If the email below doesn’t have an account yet (or hasn’t been confirmed), a confirmation link usually arrives within a few minutes. If you don’t see it, check your Spam folder and double-check the address. If you already have an account, <login>sign in</login> or use <forgot>Forgot password</forgot>.

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.description: Enter the email you registered with and we'll send you a link to reset your password.
forgot.sent: If the email below has an account, a password reset link will arrive within a few minutes (it can only be used once). If you don’t see it, check your Spam folder or try again in a few minutes.

reset.title: Reset password
reset.description: Choose a new password for {email}. Other devices that are signed in will be signed out.
reset.success: Your new password has been saved. Sessions on other devices have been revoked.
reset.noSessionTitle: This link is no longer valid
reset.noSession: Open the link in your password reset email again, or request a new one.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.emailLead: Press the button below to activate your Nhà Sách Mây account.
confirm.recoveryLead: Press the button below to continue and choose a new password.
confirm.why: The link works only once. This extra step stops link scanners in your mailbox from using it up before you do.
confirm.invalid: This link is missing information. Open the link in your email again or request a new one.
confirm.networkError: We couldn’t reach the server to confirm. The link still works: check your connection and try again.

auth.rateLimitedSeconds: We’re limiting requests for a moment to keep accounts safe. Please try again in {seconds} seconds.

resend.sent: If this email still needs confirming, a confirmation email will arrive within a few minutes. If you don’t see it, check your Spam folder or try again in a few minutes.

auth.noScriptSubmit: Turn on JavaScript to submit this form.

myListings.title: My listings
myListings.lead: Sell your used books in the Used Books market. New or edited listings are reviewed by the store before they go public.
myListings.emptyTitle: You haven’t listed any books yet
myListings.emptyDescription: Finished a book? List it with real photos of your copy; once the store approves it, it appears in the Used Books market.

conditionHint.like_new: Barely read: no creases, no marks.
conditionHint.good: Read, with a firm spine and pages; may have small marks.
conditionHint.fair: Visible wear: worn spine, light stains, creases.
conditionHint.worn: Heavily used but complete and readable.

withdraw.question: Withdraw this listing? It can’t be reopened and its photos will be deleted.

form.bookSearchHint: You can only list books the store carries. Type at least 2 characters.

form.priceHint: Up to {max}: no higher than the book’s original price.
form.priceHintNoBook: No higher than the book’s original price.

errors.PAYOUT_STATUS_CHANGED: This payout was just updated elsewhere. Reload the page to see its latest status.

This count includes photos of listings that are pending, for sale or rejected, and photos uploaded but not yet posted; unposted photos older than 24 hours are cleared when you open the new or edit listing page. Remove photos from a rejected listing or withdraw a listing you no longer want to sell, then try again.
errors.PREFS_LIMIT: You’ve hidden {max} items, the most one account can have. Unhide a few on your Preferences page, then try again.
errors.WARNING_QUOTA_EXCEEDED: AI content warning suggestions are used up for now (per-minute or daily limit, keeping requests for the Mây chatbot). Try again later, or choose the labels for the book yourself and save.
errors.SUGGESTION_STATUS_CHANGED: This suggestion was just approved or dismissed elsewhere. Reload the page to see its latest status.
